proposed_comments.body:
### Reject unknown nested input properties (2/2)

**Severity:** `medium`

Apply both parts together. Deserialize with the cached strict options from part 1 so `{"layouts":{"templates":[{"type":"focus","zoneCounnt":4}]}}` fails before any file is written. The existing `CreateFunctionDataWithInput` handler already reports the resulting `JsonException` through the DSC error channel.

```suggestion
            Input = node.Deserialize<LayoutsResourceObject>(_inputSerializerOptions) ?? new();
```

Repair a malformed custom-layout file when managing an empty section
proposed_comments.body:
### Repair a malformed custom-layout file when managing an empty section

**Severity:** `medium`

A malformed `custom-layouts.json` is warned about and represented as empty state. An explicit `custom: []` then compares equal, so `SetState` is skipped and reports success without replacing the malformed file. Treat the existing custom-file read warning as a difference as well as comparing the canonical data. This is limited to the managed custom section; omitted sections remain untouched. Verify that the first set writes valid empty JSON and a second command has no warning or diff.

```suggestion
        if (desired.Custom != null &&
            (Warnings.Any(warning => warning.StartsWith($"{CustomLayoutsFileName} is malformed", StringComparison.Ordinal)) ||
             !AreEqual(SortByUuid(desired.Custom), SortByUuid(current.Custom ?? []))))
```
